excerpt_i18n.en: It's easy to think about AI as a sort of existential battle between human and machine. Maybe it will be, someday, in a Skynet sort of way. But there are also lots of people trying to figure out how to use AI not as a replacement for human creativity and thinking but as a tool […]
excerpt_i18n.zh: 人们很容易将人工智能视为人类与机器之间的一场生存之战。也许有一天，它会像天网那样成为现实。但也有许多人正努力探索如何将人工智能用作一种工具，而非替代品。
excerpt_i18n.es: Es fácil pensar en la inteligencia artificial como una especie de batalla existencial entre el ser humano y la máquina. Quizá lo sea algún día, al estilo de Skynet. Pero también hay mucha gente intentando averiguar cómo usar la IA no como un reemplazo, sino como una herramienta para potenciar las capacidades humanas.

items.title: Nested Learning: A new ML paradigm for continual learning
items.raw_excerpt: Google Research introduces 'Nested Learning', a new machine learning paradigm designed for continual learning scenarios. It addresses catastrophic forgetting by creating nested model structures that allow systems to learn new tasks without losing previously acquired knowledge.

title_i18n.en: Nested Learning: A new ML paradigm for continual learning
title_i18n.zh: 嵌套学习：一种面向持续学习的新机器学习范式
title_i18n.es: Aprendizaje Anidado: Un nuevo paradigma de aprendizaje automático para el aprendizaje continuo

excerpt_i18n.en: Google Research introduces 'Nested Learning', a new machine learning paradigm designed for continual learning scenarios. It addresses catastrophic forgetting by creating nested model structures that allow systems to learn new tasks without losing previously acquired knowledge.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 谷歌研究团队提出了一种名为“嵌套学习”的新型机器学习范式，专门针对持续学习场景设计。该范式通过构建嵌套的模型结构，使系统能够在不遗忘旧知识的情况下持续学习新任务，有望解决传统机器学习中的灾难性遗忘问题。

items.title: Google Titans architecture, helping AI have long-term memory
items.raw_excerpt: Google researchers introduced the Titans architecture to provide AI systems with long-term memory capabilities, enhancing their ability to retain and utilize historical information for improved continuous learning.

title_i18n.en: Google Titans architecture, helping AI have long-term memory
title_i18n.zh: 谷歌泰坦架构，助力人工智能拥有长期记忆。
title_i18n.es: La arquitectura de Titanes de Google, que ayuda a la inteligencia artificial a tener memoria a largo plazo

excerpt_i18n.en: Google researchers introduced the Titans architecture to provide AI systems with long-term memory capabilities, enhancing their ability to retain and utilize historical information for improved continuous learning.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 谷歌研究团队推出Titans架构，旨在为人工智能系统提供长期记忆能力。该架构通过改进记忆机制，帮助AI模型更好地保留和利用历史信息，提升持续学习性能。
